method: Read-only live checks of the owned homepage, robots file and sitemap, plus a four-query public web-search sample. No authenticated webmaster account was used.

queries: Mythical Void browser game creatures NASA
publicSearchSample.sampleSource: Public web search available to the studio; not an authenticated Google Search Console property.
publicSearchSample.limitations: This is a small, dated search sample. Results vary by engine, location, time, language and personalisation. No observed result does not prove that every search engine has failed to index the site.

observedGap: The site is technically open to crawling, but public discovery was not demonstrated. The prepared /story/ route is also absent from the current live sitemap snapshot.
interpretation: The crawl foundation is present. The studio cannot yet tell whether the missing public results are caused by a new or unsubmitted site, delayed indexing, weak authority, or another coverage issue without verified Search Console evidence.
nextKevinAction: When convenient, use the existing Google account to verify mythicalvoid.com in Search Console, submit https://mythicalvoid.com/sitemap.xml, and return the coverage result. This does not require creating a new Mythical Void email address.
nextStudioAction: Keep the current sitemap and canonical pages accurate. Do not claim indexing, rankings or search traffic until authenticated evidence exists.
